thread:
Riley: follow-up from the postmortem: need a concise owners-and-deadlines plan to cut alert noise for Redis flaps and background-worker errors. Key goals: reduce paging for transient spikes, tighten thresholds where safe, add dedupe windows, and add verification steps.

Noah: I'll own redis-conn and redis-latency alerts. Plan: increase threshold for short-lived latency blips (95th from 150ms -> 250ms) and add 3m burst suppression. Will canary to staging Thu.

Priya: I'll update the incidents runbook: add suppression-review checklist and mark which alerts must always page (P0/P1). Also add a rollback clause if suppressions hide >2 true incidents in 24h. PR by Wed.

Noah: for dedupe, propose default 8m for flapping redis alerts, but with an escalation rule: if suppressed_count >= 3 in 60m, force a page. I'll run tests in staging Fri AM.

Riley: please add a short smoke test before prod rollout. Example command to simulate spikes and validate paging: 

```
# generate short bursts against staging redis proxy
for i in 1 2; do seq 1 100 | xargs -n1 -P40 curl -sS https://staging/redis/proxy/health || echo spike; sleep 20; done
```

oncall-bot: created task INFR-2999 "Redis alert sweep: thresholds, suppression, dedupe" assigned to Noah, due 2026-04-06.

Noah: will paste canary logs and dashboard links to the task. After staging validation I'll roll to prod with 48h monitoring.

Priya: timeline summary: Noah (thresholds + dedupe tests) canary Thu, prod Fri; Priya runbook Wed. Riley to notify PM/support.

Riley: agreed. Add verification note to task when done. Tagging @incident-review for visibility. End of thread.
